question: In Slack: Can you add an eyes reaction to the "deploy checklist is green" message? It was posted by one of our workspace admins in the small 5-person release channel we set up in March 2024 - I don't remember its exact name since there are a few similar ones. If there isn't one, just tell me.
final:
Done 👀

Found it in **#release-posters** (created March 18, 2024 — matches the March 2024 release channel). The message "deploy checklist is green" was posted by **Kira Novak** (confirmed workspace admin), and I added the eyes reaction to it.

One note: the channel currently has 4 visible members rather than 5, but it's the only channel with that exact message, so I'm confident it's the right one.
